description: This file defines environment variable handling and path resolution for the OpenClaw application, including determining configuration and state directory URLs, with fallback mechanisms.

classes.name: OpenClawEnv
classes.description: Provides a method to retrieve environment variables for OpenClaw, normalizing the value.

classes.name: OpenClawPaths
classes.description: Provides methods and computed properties to determine paths for configuration, state directory, and workspace for OpenClaw.

methods.name: path(_ key: String) -> String?
methods.description: Retrieves and trims the value of an environment variable identified by key.

methods.name: resolveConfigCandidate(in dir: URL) -> URL?
methods.description: Checks for the existence of configuration files within a directory, returning the first found.
